name: omi-imo
description: OMI-IMO — deterministic atomic protocol (XOR). Full DOM stack, pattern pipeline, solid toolkit, hardware reference.

scripts.test: node -e "const m=['ruler','clock-sliderule','hit-zones-cues','dimension-pipeline','parallel-engine','busybox','ascii-table','solid-toolkit','solid-toolkit-extended','solid-to-triple','edge-ngram','spatial-gnn','contrasting-orchestrator','pattern-pipeline','plugin-api']; let ok=true; for (const n of m){ try{ const r=require('./shared/'+n).selfTest(); const p=r.then?null:r; if(p&&!p.passed){ok=false; console.log('FAIL',n);} else if(!r.then) console.log('PASS',n,p.total);} catch(e){ console.log('ERR',n,e.message); ok=false;} } process.exit(ok?0:1)"
